```yaml
name: Social Copy Generator

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [edited]

jobs:
  post_initial_comment:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.action == 'opened'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Post comment with generate checkbox
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const body = `<!-- social-copy-generator -->\n[ ] Generate social media copies`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.payload.pull_request.number,
              body
            });

  generate_social_copies:
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'issue_comment' &&
      github.event.action == 'edited' &&
      github.event.issue.pull_request &&
      github.event.comment.body.includes('<!-- social-copy-generator -->') &&
      github.event.comment.body.includes('[x]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Get PR diff
        id: diff
        run: |
          git fetch origin ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }} --depth=1
          diff=$(git diff origin/${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}..HEAD)
          echo "diff<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$diff" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Generate social copies with Claude
        id: claude
        uses: anthropic/claude-code@v1
        with:
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          prompt: |
            You are a social media copywriter. Analyze the following PR diff and generate concise, engaging copy for:
            1. Twitter/X (280 characters)
            2. LinkedIn (up to 700 characters)
            3. Blog post (short intro, 150-200 words)

            Output the result in markdown with sections titled "Twitter/X", "LinkedIn", and "Blog Post". Do not include any code fences or extra commentary.

            PR diff:
            ${{ env.diff }}
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Update comment with results
        if: steps.claude.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const generated = `## Social Media Copies

### Twitter/X
${{ steps.claude.outputs.output.split('### Twitter/X')[1].split('### LinkedIn')[0] }}

### LinkedIn
${{ steps.claude.outputs.output.split('### LinkedIn')[1].split('### Blog Post')[0] }}

### Blog Post
${{ steps.claude.outputs.output.split('### Blog Post')[1] }}

[ ] Regenerate`;
            await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              comment_id: context.payload.comment.id,
              body: generated
            });

      - name: Update comment with error
        if: steps.claude.outcome != 'success'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const errorMsg = `❌ **Error generating social copies**. Check the workflow logs for details: ${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const body = `<!-- social-copy-generator -->\n${errorMsg}\n\n[ ] Regenerate`;
            await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              comment_id: context.payload.comment.id,
              body
            });
```
